name: Pomelo STEM Mascot
summary: Original procedural Pomelo STEM fruit mascot with a static hero pose and six-expression kit.
description: An original fruit mascot built procedurally in Blender. The registered export is a static, one-metre happy hero pose; the source folder also contains a standing export and a kit with six static expressions.
author: Original owner-project procedural model
creation_method: Procedural character geometry and materials generated with Blender from generate.py; the registered hero is static, with standing and six-expression kit GLBs kept as additional source exports.
accuracy_notes: A strict independent reviewer estimated visual similarity to the owner's design board at about 67%. Colour, hand and foot shape, face depth, and expression scale remain visibly different; the shell reads greener and less lemon-yellow, the inset is shallower, and hands and shoes are simplified. The model is more regular and upright than the illustration. Its main proportions meet the board's targets: head height is 63.8% of total height, head width is about 77% of total height, and body width is about 62% of head width. The kit contains separate static expressions, not shape keys or animation. The private board is not redistributed.

attribution.credit: Original procedural character geometry and materials generated with Blender 5.2.3 LTS for the owner's project; no third-party model is included.
Generic mesh/export helpers adapted from an authorized read-only example.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
